AND a.BALANCE_DATE <=STR_TO_DATE(#{balanceDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')

null) OR a.FINPROD_ID in (
#{finprodId}

select distinct SUBJECT_NO as id, SUBJECT_NAME as text FROM BOK_SUBJECT WHERE 1 = 1 AND BOOKSET_ID IN ( SELECT BOOKSET_ID_TMPL FROM BOK_BOOKSET WHERE ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE ='BANK' )
AND SUBJECT_LEVEL = #{subjectLevel}

SELECT DISTINCT a.FINPROD_ID AS id, fin.FINPROD_ABBR AS text FROM BOK_BANK_BALANCE a LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fin ON a.FINPROD_ID = fin.FINPROD_ID WHERE 1=1
AND (a.FINPROD_ID like concat_ws('%',concat_ws(#{search},'%')) OR fin.FINPROD_ABBR like concat_ws('%',concat_ws(#{search},'%')))
